payload.entry: LAND AUDIT: Read this epic and every note on all four closed children, audited plan:202610/bare_x_close.md, and reviewed bob-cli commits c166ed2 (parser), 6bc432b (retirement), 0f47802 (docs) and bob-mac-capture 2c007c7 (Mac). Only authorized glossary:capture and glossary:bulk-capture changed; no decision record or other memory was edited. Reviewed intervening commits 85eac25/c4ac06f/fa7745f/5848c39/4703619 (reference intake), b291f23 (Reading Board docs), de78e98 (added_at), and Mac bc6eb30/5a0bff5/7d6063a (Refs race/Newest): no feature overlap requiring bare-x integration changes found. Other child notes contain verification claims, no additional proposals. Separately discovered Mac CI 39164361288 on 2c007c7 passed lint/build but could not compile tests because RefsNewestTests.zone conflicts with NSObject.zone(); blame identifies 5a0bff5/bob-cli-9d.2. Named tool check is unavailable (sase tool run check reports unknown tool), so use SASE_TOOL_BYPASS with the raw gate.
